plan.notes: Source: official NYIT (New York Institute of Technology) semester map, 'COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING AND COMPUTING SCIENCES - BACHELOR OF SCIENCE IN COMPUTER SCIENCE - ADMITTED IN 2024-2025 ACADEMIC YEAR' (rev 2/24), hosted on web.nyit.edu. Cross-checked against NYIT's current semester-map web page (https://site.nyit.edu/semester-map/computer_science_bs), which shows the identical 8-term sequence for the general Computer Science B.S. Transcribed by hand from the official PDF; no courses, credits, or prerequisites invented. The PDF header prints 'CREDITS 122-124' (range depends on concentration/elective selections); the map's own published term totals are 16+17+15+15+15+15+17+14 = 124, so total_credits is 124 with the 122-124 range documented here. NYIT publishes concentration-specific maps for 2025-2026 and 2026-2027 (AI, Big Data Management and Analytics, Network Security, General); this 2024-2025 'all concentrations' map is the newest single general CS B.S. sequence and matches the current web-published map. Concentration slots model the 12-credit requirement: Big Data Management and Analytics (e.g. CSCI 401, CSCI 405, CSCI 415, CSCI 426, CSCI 436), Network Security (e.g. CSCI 352, CSCI 354, CSCI 357, CSCI 362, CSCI 440, CSCI 445), or General Option (four 300-400 level CSCI/ITEC courses excluding CSCI 316 and CSCI 317). Map rules noted on the source: students must receive C or higher in all required ETCS, CSCI, EENG, and ITEC courses; course names/numbers/prerequisites subject to change. Prereq notes transcribe the official map's placement/co-req alternatives honestly (e.g. MATH 136/141 placement alternatives and MATH 161 alternative for CSCI 235) rather than re-writing them as course conjunctions.
